caption:
Happy Thanksgiving! A quick speed drill before the turkey. 🦃⚡

Push the ground sideways, stick the landing. Golfers who produce more force into the ground tend to swing faster, and this trains that push plus control.
✅ 3 x 5 each way, full rest between sets
✅ Push off hard, then freeze for 2 seconds on the landing leg
❌ Don't let the knee cave in or take extra hops to balance

Send this to your golf buddy who wants more yards.
